read_me: WhatsApp templates: All 54 templates (smo_m1_01 ... smo_m6_09) were submitted to Meta through Gallabox on 30 Oct 2026: category Marketing, the exact text of each message, no variables, no buttons. Status when submitted: pending approval. Check them in Gallabox > Templates.

Do not change approved text: A template sends the text Meta approved. If you change a message's text here or on the Nudges page, its template no longer matches: submit a new template (a new name, e.g. smo_m1_01_v2), put that name in the WhatsApp template column, and wait for approval.

Who gets which: Customer messaged the bot in the last 24 hours: the message goes as a normal WhatsApp message - no template needed. Last message over 24 hours ago: only the approved template can be sent (WhatsApp's rule for every business).

US (+1) numbers: The bot sends approved templates to every number, US included. Meta has paused delivering Marketing templates to US numbers since April 2025 (no end date announced); while that lasts, Meta reports those sends as not delivered.
Dish names: The handoff says the dish names in the text are examples: check them against the live menu before switching the campaign on.

Festival messages: M4-01, M4-04 and M4-08 speak of festivals and occasions in general terms and go in month 4 like the rest, as the handoff lists them. For a real festival (e.g. Diwali), add a separate message with From, Until, Order by and Kitchens filled in.
Importing: Nudges > Messages > Import, choose this file, check, then Import. Importing again updates the messages by ID and changes nothing else. Only the Messages sheet is read.
